tables.name: open_saving_logs
tables.description: Log of open digital-savings-account activity, used to support marketing. Data date T-1.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer ID of the customer who did the action

columns.name: mymo_user_id
columns.description: MyMo user ID, present only after login

columns.name: os
columns.description: OS name, pulled from the vipera standard header field (os)

columns.name: os_version
columns.description: OS version, pulled from the vipera standard header field (osVersion)

columns.name: mymo_version
columns.description: MyMo app version, pulled from the vipera standard header field (version)

columns.name: client_ip
columns.description: Client IP address, logged by vipera

columns.name: operation
columns.description: Operation performed: createDigitalSavingsApplicationForm (apply), validateDigitalSavingsQualificationCard (enter ID card back number), validateDigitalSavingsOTP (verify OTP), submitDigitalSavings (complete account opening, sends email)

columns.name: application_form_id
columns.description: Application form ID, generated by the createDigitalSavingsApplicationForm operation
